review_description: We got a great setup at a very competitive price, delivered and installed very smoothly.One thing I really enjoyed was the efficient and convenenient email communications with little/no sales push from Helio.  Every email, every answer, every quote was well educated, concise and super clear which made the whole process easy.Other companies were pushy or pushing specific brands whereas Helio advised brands and models but were open to others, and at a similarly good price. There communications, openess and pricing was refreshing and honest.The system was installed and finished in a single day, guys were polite, absolutely zero mess, super easy.

Helioenergy came on site to discuss approach. I discussed a number of different configurations and Shan was always responsive and patient.Installation was efficient and clean. They needed to move my TV aerial and we didn't like where they put it, so they moved it again, no fuss, just got it done.Installed the inverter with care over the aesthetics on the house.One roof tile was broken and the team replaced it when I was not even home, they said they'd do it and they did.Helped with the grid connection, end to end the job was done really quickly and professionally.
A very prompt and honest approach, and very good technical knowledge and skills.

Shan and his team installed our solar panels 5 years ago.The system paid for itself in 3 years and i have been very impressed with his after service.Battery was installed with the highest possible of professionalism.I am very happy to highly recommend him. The Tesla Powerwall is working wonderfully with our cells.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. HelioEnergy get top marks because Shan turned up at our door within 24 hours and carried out a site inspection.  From that we had site-specific solutions that other suppliers didn't match.  It meant the products and the installation worked perfectly for our situation.  The product recommendation (new Sigenergy 24Kw system + EV charger) was great;  The quote was very competitive; The install was prompt and carried out very successfully by their own polite and tidy team (not sub-contractors). The guys worked really hard and late into the evening on a tricky install. Our own network problems delayed full operational capacity, but it was sorted with good support from the manufacturer. Shan and his team were great to deal with and I have been recommending them to all my friends who are interested in battery/ EV solutions.

The team from Helioenergy were very responsive and took the time to explain their proposed solution and the benefits for its installation. They explained the indicative savings based on size and position, potential alternatives and gave a comprehensive explanation of their installation process.Once the quote was accepted they provided an installation window, once we agreed on the date they arrived as agreed. The were quick, clean and tidy. We are very happy with the installed system which is operating as indicated.I would be happy to recommend them based on price, quality of installation and customer communication.

Helioenergy provided us with a competitive quote for our needs, explained it carefully l, installed it professionally as quoted while also accommodating a last minute change from us, and were on hand both on the day and afterwards to explain the operation of the system to us.

The whole process with Shan and the Helioeeneegy team was seamless and painless.The initial quoting and the answering of questions was extremely quick and efficient in comparison  to other companies.  There was no sales pitch, just facts and straightforward answers. Pricing was also extremely competitive.The installation was done over 2 days and the system has been working fine in the past 2 weeks since installation.I would highly recommend Shan to anyone looking at a solar system.
The owner of business did the quote - he was very knowledgeable.  The installer and his workers were all polite and punctual as well as tidy.
Shan and his team were punctual, proffessional, courteous and informative to any of our questions during, before and after installation.
I chose Tesla Powerwall 3 which takes time for the system to be shipped from the USA. I was told that installation would take place next week.

I had quotes from 4 vendors. We chose a standard economical installation with a battery.We did have to wait a few weeks between signing up and installation but it was understandable the installers were busy because a lot of people are trying to take up the government subsidy.The installation took a day. The apps and equipment was easy to understand. We are generating more power than we need with a fully charged battery every evening, even on rainy days. The only change we adopted is we try to only run our washing machine and dishwasher during the day.

I have a two-pump pool system and reverse cycle AC so I have been spending close to $5k pa on power.  I found HelioEnergy with the help of SolarQuotes.com.auHelioEnergy's representative came to discuss my requirements, plan a panel layout and quote for a panel/battery installation.  He clearly explained a number of options.  The quote was very competitive.  After I accepted it and paid the deposit there was a delay due to short-term unavailability of the particular battery I required.  Once stock was available (a delay of about 3-4 weeks) the same man called to arrange a date for installation.HelioEnergy arrived on schedule and installed/commissioned the system in one day.  One thing I particularly liked is that they do not use sub-contractors - everyone who worked on the installation is from HelioEnergy.The man in charge on the day (the senior licensed electrician) was the same person who came to plan/quote the system - I liked that.  Dealing with the same person at every stage gives one confidence in the process - confidence that there won't be any surprises or misunderstandings. This proved to be the case - the installation I have is exactly what I understood I was buying.He did not leave until 8pm due to the time taken to download software updates to the battery, but he was clearly someone who "does what it takes" and he made sure everything was working properly before he left.It's been running now for nearly 2 weeks. I guess it's early days yet, but on the figures I'm seeing from the monitoring App I'm expecting my installation to pay for itself within 4 years.I thoroughly recommend HelioEnergy as a professional and trustworthy supplier/installer of solar.

Company visited to design installation layout as I have a two storey dwelling next door.  Quick, efficient installation by company's own employees-no contractors. Rapid responses to any queries after installation.

Well detailed quote with choices of system. Listened to our requirements. Answered all questions satisfactorily. Easy to talk to. Workers efficient and polite. Everything checked at the end and explained with help accessing details for the app.
Extremely happy with the whole process. From quoting to responsiveness on emails to installation. Work is tidy and they cleaned up after themselves.

Very happy with the pre-sales process and installation. What stood out for me was the time and care HelioEnergy had taken to explain their proposal with different options and answer my many questions. Pre-installation site visit was comprehensive and again offered opportunity to fine tune the location of panels and inverter, with explanations for their recommendations. Installers were approachable, polite and took care with their work. I did include a Green Catch Power diverter for my hot water heater in the setup - glad I did otherwise I'd be exporting electricity only to import it again at night. No post-installation faults or issues yet, and hopefully none for many years, so I haven't yet needed to make a support or warranty call.
Shan was a gentlemen to deal with. Installation was professional and clean.

Process from quoting to installation to post install review was very good. Happy to visit site before and after installation to make sure I was getting the correct size system as well as answering any post installation questions I had. Installers were courteous and cleaned up any mess.

Helioenergy were super clear and detailed with the quotation and explained the pros and cons of different manufacturers and invertersInstallation was smooth and after sales support was great after I reset my wifi.
Shan was very knowledgeable and offered the right advice and price.A team of young installers was very efficient, respectful and friendly.They also set the monitoring application.Highly recommend.

Honest, fast, reliable and respectful. Helioenergy stood out from all the other companies. They were very clear, they came to our home, and provided an honest proposal based on our needs. Helioenergy adjusted to our needs, listened to the questions and answered very clearly. The quote was also very clear, explaining exactly what was the pay and what was the STC rebate.The delivery was 2 days after I agreed on the installation. They came and smoothly did the job, on time. They have also avoided any outside cables, making the job also very elegant and neat. I can only recommend this company.

The quoting process was smooth, responsive and attentive. The installation team was efficient, respectful and professional. Excellent customer service. Helped to organise all the necessary paperwork and showed me how to install and use the monitoring App.

Dealing with Shan from Helios was a pleasure, from scheduling an onsite visit, to sharing of suggestions and discussing pros and cons of different sized and phased systems, to the flexibility in providing a quotes multiple quotes each with different branded and phased products. Installation and grid connecting timings needed to be on different dates, which was offered at no additional cost. And post installation support to connect my inverter to the home.wifi, 6 months after installation, one building works had completed, a breeze to arrange. No pressure sales tactics, just friendly, reliable and well priced customer service. Wholeheartedly recommend anyone to ask Shan from Helios to install a solar energy system.

Quoted over the xmas period and kept me updated with install date given time of year. They were able to lock me in the first week he was back.  Competitively priced. He showed he cared by coming back for 2-3 hrs and tweaking my system to get the maximum kwh. Have recommended to neighbour's and friends

Shan was able to clearly explain all the options available and the pros and cons of each and more than happy to answer all the various questions. Arrived on time, left the property free of rubbish And I received 2 follow up calls to ensure everything is functioning as expected.

Shan was friendly and knowledgeable, explained and recommended the best option for my requirement.The installation happened few days after agreeing on the quote and was performed by a team of skillful and efficient young men.They also helped to install and activate a monitoring mobile app.I do recommend this installer.

1) The sales/quoting process - minor hiccup. However Shan Gao and I managed to iron out the confusion.2) The installation - was successful. Installer was polite, efficient, tidy and punctual.3) The customer service - very responsive and attentive. E.g. minor condensation built up inside the isolator box, Helioenergy came on site to inspect and working hard to address the issue.

Quote was very competitive, Shan was very accommodating, and thorough. The crew were very efficient and professional in installing the solar panels, inverter, and battery, even upgrading my old switchboard. Shan organized all the paperwork with my energy provider and spent time explaining things to me. He also spent time to fine-tune the system.  Great job guys!

Shan and his team did a great job.Initial quote offered many options.After a few emails and phone calls we agreed on a system. Shan always was available quickly by email and phone which was not the case with many other suppliers. The price was very competitive.A site visit ensured that everything was in orderThe installation team arrived on time and finished the job with no issues (or broken tiles)Shan was able to help with some software queries a few days after as well as send staff to realign a panel.In short very pleasantly surprised sales, installation and support.The panels and inverter are working great.

Received 3 quotes promptly.Selected one based on customer reviews on Solarquotes website as well as lowest price.Helio Energy was flexible; Installers were efficient, courteous, and tidy.After installation information and system explanation were thorough.An excellent installation and the system has worked extremely well so far.

Best system offered - we got quoted the largest kWh system and with the most attractive price.Mr. Shan is the owner, sales person and installer. The installation was immaculate. He installed our wall charger for a small fee. His team helped us change some broken tiles while they are on the roof.He is easy going and very easy to speak to. Full of knowledge and very humble person.Sales/Quote - Value for moneyInstallation quality - Excellent. Conduits are run neatly. No rubbish left behind.Customer service - Excellent. Lots of consultation on where to locate the wall charger and the PV box.

Shan Gao of Helio understood our request, made timely and sensible amendmemts and corrections where needed.  His quote was also at the lower end.   Overall we were very happy with what was proposed and the time it took for everything to be completed.  The crew were efficient, respectful and communicated when they would be around and doing their various steps clearly.Only downside was the length of time it took red energy to install the smart meter (almost a month after we had the panels installed) and for them to communicate with us over the tariffs we would be on.
Very happy with the full process from requesting a quote to installation

I was initially happy when the system was installed in April 2023 and service seemed very good.However the SolarEdge inverter began glitching in the summer heat. A case was promptly opened with SolarEdge  early December, 2 months ago, but Helioenergy have failed to provide any follow through. I contacted SolarEdge myself to find the case had been closed with no resolution.Helioenergy failed to respond to emails and when I called them the calls seemed to fielded by call center personnel who promise a callback. Still waiting for that after 24hrs.I don't think I could recommend Helioenergy at the moment.

Helio was great from beginning to end.  Shan is the main point of contact and he was very helpful in producing a range of options for me to consider and discuss options.  His installation team was punctual and tidy and no fuss.  The system is working well.  Thank you Shan and the Helio team

Before choosing Helioenergy, I did a lot of research on solar system and contacted in total six installers. Among them, Mr. Gao at Helioenergy is the only one who was able to answer all my questions and to solve all my enquiries. I am deeply impressed by his rich knowledge, experience, and expertise. Mr. Gao knows the detailed features of all types of solar panels and inverters. I struggled with choosing the “right” type of inverter for my house. He visited my home and provided a customized solution based on our requirements and the condition of the house. Smooth communication with Mr. Gao and his team, no matter on the phone or face to face. Moreover, I would also like to address that Helioenergy is one of the longest serving solar power and renewable energy companies in Australia. The fact itself has already demonstrated the quality and value of their installation work and customer services.In summary, professional, punctual, and efficient team. A big thank to Mr. Gao and his colleagues. Without a doubt, I highly recommend Mr. Gao and Helioenergy to anyone seeking for a high-quality and efficient installation of solar system.

I was quoted the system that would be suitable and they also quoted another says them based on the panels and inverters that I wanted. Good value for the system capacity.They installed it all in the one day and the system met the needs of my existing power consumption. Very professional installation team, I was impressed. I'm very happy with my system.

Shan was very professional in his engagement and provided honest advice on sizing, location etc. Helio energy was extremely competitive on price and their efficient, non-intrusive installation ticked all the boxes.Very happy to recommend Shan and his team.
HelioEnergy provided a prompt, very competitive quote and followed up with what appears to be a quality installation.  So far, I am very happy with my choice.
Great people to discuss requirements with. Came and did a site visit and happy to discuss all the aspects of the installation. No mess afterwards

Quick and neat installation.Smooth and trouble free installation process.Workmanship in laying the solar panels is just fair as there are up and down in the panel alignment, but it is structural acceptable.Overall quite happy with Shan, especially with the system price and the follow up works in fixing the inverter network issue.Will give feedback again in the future relating to the system performance.

Not only did they beat the other's quotes by a wide margin, they offered the widest range of options than the others. They were very responsive to my email queries, even post installation.Installation took a couple of days due to weather but they were quite adaptable and the time between go-ahead to finished was only a couple of weeks.They only negative I have was the tidy up could have been better as there was some plastic off-cuts and filings left around.

Helioenergy provided me with a range of different options and solutions at very competitive prices. The quotes were informative and provided top of the range products as well as cost effective products meeting my budget.Once I selected a solution meeting my needs Helioenergy responded promptly with the steps I needed to do next and provided an estimate of when installation would proceed.Closer to the week of installation I received a call from Helioenergy confirming the date of installation. The installation itself went smoothly and the tradies were punctual, polite and willing to answer any questions I had. The installation of the panels, cabling and inverters looks professional and neat.The customer service provided by Helioenergy is top notch. They have organised the grid connection as well as the meter re-configuration and have answered any questions I've had after the installation.So far I am very happy that I chose Helioenergy and I can highly recommend them to anyone looking to install solar panels.
9 quotes, this was by far the best system for the price

The experience of Shan showed throughout the engagement. In pre-sales he spotted roof installation issues va the aerial photography that others didn't, and took the time to ask questions to make sure he understood my requirements. (adding 9kW & powerwall to an existing system).   Pricing was very sharp first time around (other installers only came back with competitive pricing 2nd time around). Shan was on-site throughout installation and happy to take time and answer my (perhaps dumb) questions.  After being installed, we asked to shift a few panels for aesthetics - again no problems or drama.   His team even noticed a leak in a skylight and offered to silicone it for us while up there!   I could not recommend HelioEnergy more highly.
Helio Energy was able to supply panels others were having trouble sourcing, great communication throughout the process and smooth installation. Would happily recommend

All round great experience. Supplier answered all our questions and took the time to visit to be sure we understood everything. on the day of installation the actual installer team was courteous and worked without fuss.
Good quotes for a range of systems including the brands we wanted. Seamless installation and grid connection with no issues. The team of installers were polite and friendly.

Shan was super helpful providing a range or quotes/systems to suit our needs. Best value for money compared to other solar companies. Installation was tidy and clean - very happy as it was a slightly difficult installation.

We received a number quotes from 4 separate accredited installers. Only HelioEnergy proposals offered us a good range of price points (reflecting combination of different panel brands and different size systems). This enabled us to compare against the other installer quotes received & decide on the price point & componentry right for us to achieve a balance between quality+performance stats of  the components vs overall system size. Dealing with Shan (& his team) from the start through to completion of installation (as scheduled) couldn’t have been easier.

Helio has a team with strong technical ability and made it easy to explaining the system (technically) and based on my requirements.Was not the cheapest as there are always compromises when going for a cheaper system. I wanted a company with their own installers and to get the maximum capacity for a single phase home. Also wanted a system with higher quality (longer warranty) so we went for the 10KW Solar Edge inverter with Power Optimizers on each panel (Q Cells - Made in Korea).Also are about to get an EV (Model Y) and had our Tesla Gen 3 charger installed at the same time for a very very small fee. Installation took 1.5 day and we had 32 panels. Q Cells are made in South Korea and much better quality. When battery costs come down I will install Tesla Powerwall (system is battery ready). Current cost is $16K for the Tesla Powerwall Gen 2 battery but I heard a new generation will be available next year using LFP.

Dealing with Shan and the HelioEnergy team was a smooth and enjoyable experience from start to finish,The team was knowledgeable, professional and tidy on the installation. They came on time and were very accommodating when I needed to customise some of the installation process.I spoke to several installers during the initial quotes and am very happy to have gone with HelioEnergy.Very highly recommended.

I cannot speak highly enough of the service we recieved from Helio Energy from start to finish. In quoting they simply turned up and asked what our expperectiations were. There was no high pressure sales techniques, no gadgets or wizardry to confoud a confuse, just straight questions about what we wanted. They were not the cheapest quote but offered what we thought was going to be a system that would work for us. They took care of all the paperwork required by the retailers and other authorities. On installation day, the team arrived on time and worked professionally. They demonstarted high standrds of WHS. The standard of tradesmanship was excellent. They completed the job in l 1/2 days as expected and left the site clean and tidy. Ive been in the construction industry 40 years and this was up there with best teams I've worked with.So thank you Helio Energy for a great job, well done!
Provided lots of options and good information during decision process. Installers were employees and not sub contractors. Quality install and service

Quotes were very good a varied range of system size and component price range.The installation was punctual, neat and tidy.The technicians were polite and very helpful in explaining the operation of the system.They setup the inverter app on my phone and organised the grid connection.

Glad Helio was one of the companies recommended to us by Finn.Helio supplied us with several options covering a range of equipment.Went with panels and inverter etc guided by Finns list of budget to top line equipment  from his web site.Good communication and a very neat, professional install.
Installed without providing a scratch of the solar panels layout. Solar connect attempted to change my meter on April but unsuccessful and never contact me again since.

Getting quotes was simple, However one company did not respond to emails for clarifications so were discounted, One would not send someone to site until we had agreed to go with them and paid a deposit. Comparing quotes was complex as everyone used different panels and different inverter systems and you needed to get like for like quotes to compare prices. Shan from Helioenergy was happy to discuss and explain the system and to come to site (which was very useful as we could decide where to put the battery (very different from what I was expecting) and all the control modules. I was very happy with the install of the panels (one day 25 panels just before the recent rains and it was operational that day) and then when there was a break in the weather to install the battery. New meter should be installed on the day I write this. The staff from Helioenergy were punctual and worked very hard and were very professional and the job was done neatly and everything cleaned up afterwards. Would highly recommend them.

Shan was quick to respond with options, more importantly, he was not a pushy salesperson.Answers questions honestly, Install was quick, efficient and tidy.Followed up with meter change and advice on feed in tariffs.Have decided to do a 2nd install with Shan and HelioEnergy.

This 30kW system wasn't the easiest job because the panels are on a commercial building with a flat concrete roof on top of a 4 storey building.  These guys took the initiative and managed to get everything lifted up there by a crane working nearby and then completed the job quickly in the middle of COVID.  They commissioned it before summer so we have benefitted from having much smaller power bills as our electrical demand is dominated by air-con.

Quotation, scheduling and installation process was straightforward.Fast and efficient installation, given the relatively large size of the panel system.Helioenergy was able to meet challenging design considerations, given the aspect, position and available roof space of the building.
The whole process was easy and quick. Couldn't be happier.

If you are reading this review, it will save you a lot of time and hassle. Many salespeople will bother you when you start getting solar quotes. It is not recommended to choose a sales company with contractors. If you choose Helioenergy, I believe you will not regret it. Helioenergy provides Top-Quality at a competitive price.Highly recommended!!!
Process was made easy, dealt with professional and knowledgeable staff, efficient installation.

I found the quoting and follow up questions as I digested multiple quotes efficient and helpful. The installation occurred in the time frame promised (4-6 weeks) although the job was completed in 2 stages, panels first, battery later but this was ok as the weather was terrible for outside work. All communication was good and clear and removal of my old system and clear up of work materials was as I would expect. Only delay is with my energy supplier and the new smart meter but this is underway.

Unlike other quotes, Shan came out to look at the site and discuss the options, which was very helpful for our partially shaded and multi-faceted roof.  The quote was very competitively priced.The big Sydney COVID outbreak intervened between quote acceptance and installation.  We cancelled a couple of installation dates due to potential need to access inside the house while kids were home schooling.  Shan was very patient and understanding during these delays.The installation appeared very professional, with all visible and accessible parts of the system looking solidly constructed.  It was accomplished on a single day, despite running past the standard builders "knock off" time, which we appreciated.Shan helped me set up the Enphase Enlighten reporting account and app, which is working very well.

The process with Shan from the initial contact to post installation was very easy. Options provided were reasonable and the prices competitive. Installation was handled with due care. Well recommended.
Good service to date.  Generally responsive and provided guidance on options.

I really liked the way Shan talked with me over the phone during the quoting process, and then during the install. Unlike the other two companies that quoted, Shan was not pushy. He patiently answered all my questions, some of them probably a lot more detailed than what he would normally get (as I'm an electronics engineer).He was upfront with me on when they would likely be able to do the install (he said 2-3 weeks). And it turned out to be precisely in that timeframe, even with the impact of Covid.The install looks neat, all wiring is inside the roof and walls where possible.I felt Shan and his team took good care of the roof. They even went as far as replacing a few cracked tiles on a part of the roof that wasn't where they were working, just because they noticed a cracked tile there.I would not hesitate to recommend these guys to anyone. Very professional and easy to deal with.
Shan and the team at HelioEnergy are brilliant, nothing was a problem, system installed without any delays and workmanship is outstanding.I highly recommend you consider HelioEnergy.

I had a prompt respeonce from all the companies recommended.Helioenergy had the best system and the best expaination of the process.The install and the new meters from the power company were handled seamlessly, I didnt have to do anything.

Plenty of good info from the three quoters, a good range of products and flexibility. Decided to go with the lowest price for good quality 6.6kW panels and high-end 5kW inverter. Excellent installation, all professional, punctual, good comms, polite and tidy. Grid connections sorted, as was smart meter reporting (I still love checking it through the day!). Very happy with all aspects and the outcome.

Quoting is very precise and installation team member are very polite, tidy and punctual.Especially I want to mention Mr Gao’ expertise in solar. He is very knowledgeable and patient. He answered my all solar-related concerns in my circumstance and offered me a best suitable solution.Their price is competitive too. Already recommended to my friends!
Was happy with sales and quotation processinstallation was done in 2 daysthey did help with grid connection

I have found Shan Gao very knowledgeable and helpful making my decision process for my final solar power system (8.58kW) a fairly quick one. His installer crew were also polite, tidy and helpful taking just about 6 hours (including lunch and rest times) to install 22 solar panels with 22 micro inverters and production/consumption monitoring system. Grid connection application was submitted  by HelioEnergy the following day but actual meter change took nearly 3 weeks.

Helioenergy installed a 9.9kw enphase system around about 31 March 21. There customer service and installation were  excellent. We had two other quotes from SolarQuote installers. They also seemed good value - but Helioenergy were several hundred dollars cheaper - and designed the system that best suited our needs. The system seems to be working very well.

Pre-install process was great, Shan shared good description of the different parts including technical specs and recommendations and was also able to share new panels arrivals and alternatives.We originally were given an install on Monday/Tuesday, which ended up being Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday. Would have appreciated the heads up but that was mostly a factor of us trying to squiz ourselves between 2 other installs so I won't blame them on that.The installers were nice/polite and careful with anything in our home. No issues whatsoever.Once installed we had some quick help on how to setup the Enphase Enlighten app and get the information, Shan did set up the details on the panel array for us and organised the grid connection/change necessary in our electricity provided. All good!Only hiccup in that whole story is that I noticed one of the panel was producing about half of the others, which I shared with Shan who is coordinating the warranty claim. Now I can't blame Helio for a defective panel, but it would be fairly easy for them to check production on the first day to check for anomalies. Maybe they would have after a few days.Overall, very happy customer and would definitely recommend Shan / HelioEnergy to anyone & everyone.

1. They listen to me and gave me what I wanted at a good price.2. The installation went smoothly. The guys were polite and tidy.3. Customer service was excellent. They organised the connection to the grid, set up system performance and tracking on my computer. They also recommended a suppler who was giving the best feed in rate at this point in time.

Extremely happy with HelioEnergy from quoting through installation and after sales service.Process from quote to install was a little under 3 weeks.  Absolutely no sales pressure - was just given a number of options to consider.   Shan came out to inspect the site and patiently answered all of my questions.Ended up using Qcells 27 x 390 ML-G9 390watt panels to maximise limited roof space usage as wanted to future proof for upcoming needs.  Matched with enphase IQ7A (7a required as the IQ7+ rated to 385w max) microinverters due to shading issues.Installation done by HelioEnergy employees in house (not subcontracted) - the installers were very polite, methodical, efficient and very neat and tidy.   Would have been completed in one day but due to rain had to come back and finish the next morning.    Enphase programmed with panel level visibility production as well as house consumption.  Aesthetically looks great - everything lines up perfectly on the roof - all conduits neat which is important.    Got the biggest litmus test the next day with 4 days of solid rain / Sydney's flooding event - absolutely no issues with leaks.Was a very small issue with the enphase reporting very slight negative consumption over night - I was waiting for my final invoice to let them know.   Without receiving any invoice Helio called back in and fixed this proactively (was that the CT consumption monitor had some leakage and the terminals needed to be tightened a little) - and they explained it was their policy not to invoice until everything is up and working absolutely perfectly.  Turns out the enphase is smart enough to report any problems to the installer directly - how neat.  That's what I call great customer service.Very happy to recommend Helio Energy
The salesman is an engineer, I like his approach. A lot of of detail explanation.

The quotation process was easy. Once Shan got my requirements he offered various options with all the support information. Courteous and not pushy like some others.Once I was happy to go ahead, Shan came to the property to inspect the roof and switchboard to make sure there was no surprises.Installation was done on time, with minimal disruptions.Shan provided information to set up monitoring and helped to arrange authority meter replacement.So overall I’m very happy with Helioenergy and would recommended them to anyone interested in solar.
Very good and informative proposal. Arrive and finish punctual on the schedule day. Good follow up and help to organise the grid connection after the installation in one stop. Thank you.
Helio Energy where on time & helpful. Install went as planned and all commitments were completed as promised.

After talking to Shaun I decided to install 40 QCells and a 10kw fronius inverter in Feb 2019. My yearly electricity Bill's were close to $3500 a year. I produce much more electricity than I need and origin pays me 21kw h. So I earn $1400 from origin. End result will be the system will be paid off in around 2 1/2 years.Shaun and his team were excellent. Great to deal with someone who new what he was talking about and not a cowboy sales person.

Helioenergy (Shan in particular) made the whole process fuss free and simple for us. He answered all our queries and concerns, took time to come out on site and his team of installers (roofers, electrician etc) worked so efficiently on the day and were punctual and polite. It was nice to deal with the owner rather than a salesperson. They organised grid connection and provided all the paperwork. We have already recommended Helioenergy to our friends and family.Only required to gently follow up quotes but well worth the wait.
All good - very good information on system very efficient installation grid connecti.
Good price. good system, several quotes to make a decision from, fast install, organised for smart meter connection.Great to deal with and nothing to do.

We chose flat rather than angle mounting as this avoids additional wind loading and also gives a longer and flatter output over the day and seasons. This meant that we could not mount it inside one of our sealed Electrical Cupboards on the top floor and required us to run the six DC strings all the way to the MDF room. More expensive, but much safer from the point of possibly overheating the Electrical Cupboard (cutting vents in the Cupboard doors is prohibited).As it turned out, mounting the inverter in the basement MDF room was a good choice even apart from the heat factor.
